backdoor.title: Backdoor
backdoor.subtitle: Trigger interaction · stripes
backdoor.aggregation: Per-image mean absolute canonical-trigger interaction over 999 alternative class captions, on all 10,000 ImageNetV2 images.

answer_dependency.whiskers: Minimum and maximum of the three seed means, not confidence intervals.

display.x_quantity: Correct-caption or classification accuracy, as labeled in each panel.

ecdf_uncertainty: Equal-seed mean ECDF; envelope is min/max of three seed ECDFs, not a confidence interval.
retest_display: Dots show three-seed means; thin lines show seed ranges. Pale bars span seed means across all five backdoor conditions (native, JPEG90, JPEG70, resize168, resize112). Negative reduction means amplification.
